situation: I paid for my friend Leo's Taylor Swift ticket 3 weeks ago, $186. He said he'd Venmo me 'this week' and hasn't. We're close and I don't want it weird.
reply: Hey, whenever you're near your phone: $186 for the Eras ticket, I'm @maya-chen on Venmo. Just so it doesn't slip for either of us!
note: The number, what it was for and how to pay. No story, no hint. He almost certainly forgot.

situation: 去年借给大学同学小赵8000块，说好半年还，现在一年了他一直没提。我这两个月要交房租押金，确实需要这笔钱。
reply: 小赵，跟你说个事哈：去年借你的那8000块，我这边11月初要交新房子的押金，想看看能不能在10月底前先还一部分？分两次也完全没问题，你看怎么方便，给我个大概时间就行。
note: 数目、用途、截止时间都围绕自己的需要来说，不翻旧账也不评价对方，并主动给分期的台阶。

situation: My friend Jade keeps asking me to book concert and brunch stuff on my card and then pays late or forgets. She just asked me to put the $140 festival tickets on my card again.
reply: I can't front it this time, I'm keeping things tight this month. The presale opens Thursday at 10, want to both jump on at the same time and grab tickets next to each other?
note: When it's a pattern, the fix is to stop fronting money, not a sharper reminder. Keep the plan, drop the float.

situation: I reminded my friend Priya about the $64 she owes for her share of the Airbnb in Asheville and she replied 'wow, you're really chasing me over $64?' Not sure how to answer without it turning into a thing.
reply: Ha, fair, it's not a lot, which is exactly why I'd like to get it off the list. My Venmo is @tess-marlow whenever you're ready. Looking forward to tacos on Saturday.
note: When they get defensive, agree it's small, repeat the ask once and don't explain your finances. If it still doesn't come, decide whether to write it off for real.
